dataset_contract: feature2_model_ready; direct model matrices exclude provenance/origin fields

personnel.evaluation_protocol: Fixed random 80:20 split over the direct mixed training matrix. Both train and test contain the same combined real/synthetic distribution; provenance is not an input or split key.
personnel.interpretation_guardrail: Mixed-holdout performance measures fit to the configured hybrid scenario distribution, not real-world field accuracy.

fire_engine.evaluation_protocol: Fixed random 80:20 split over the direct mixed fire-engine matrix. Input is planned_personnel only.
fire_engine.selection: The deterministic six-person capacity policy remains serving logic; the booster is retained for comparison and offline experiments.
fire_engine.interpretation_guardrail: Mixed-holdout engine metrics are dominated by deterministic synthetic policy rows and do not validate incident-level deployment accuracy.

personnel.training_protocol: direct mixed matrix; no origin/provenance input

fire_engine.training_protocol: direct mixed matrix; planned_personnel is the only input
